name: Rough Quartz
summary: Rough Quartz is a humble elemental stone gifted to novice shaman by a Minor Manifestation of Earth. Though small and unrefined, it serves as the vital spiritual core needed to craft a shaman's first Earth Totem.

sections.title: Heart of the Earth Totem
sections.body: To the untrained eye, rough quartz appears to be nothing more than an ordinary desert pebble. Yet to a shaman communing with the spirits in Durotar or Mulgore, it is an elemental gift offered directly by a Minor Manifestation of Earth. The stone represents endurance, patience, and unwavering strength. When presented to an elder such as Canaga Earthcaller in the Valley of Trials, the quartz is bound into the carved wood of an Earth Totem, acting as the spiritual focus that links the fledgling shaman directly to the living soil of Azeroth.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Rough Quartz?
aliases: why do i need rough quartz
faq.answer: It serves as proof that a shaman novice has communed with the elemental earth spirit. An elder shaman uses this pebble as the spiritual core when carving the initiate's very first Earth Totem.

faq.q: Who gives you the Rough Quartz?
aliases: where do i get rough quartz
faq.answer: It is granted by a Minor Manifestation of Earth after you commune with the spirit during the Call of Earth ritual in Durotar or Mulgore.

faq.q: Who do I bring this stone to in Durotar?
aliases: where to turn in rough quartz
faq.answer: Bring it to Canaga Earthcaller, the shaman trainer residing in the Valley of Trials, who will fashion it into your Earth Totem.

faq.q: Is this quartz used for anything else?
aliases: is rough quartz used in crafting
faq.answer: No. It is purely a sacred ritual object meant solely for crafting an Earth Totem and holds no use in common trade.

angles.text: Rough Quartz represents your very first communion with the element of earth, anchoring your spells and marking your path as a true conduit of the spirits.
